comparison.objective: Open a stepladder fully and engage its spreader lock without tipping it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilize the front section while spreading the rear section until a gravity-operated notch locks.
comparison.success_condition: Sections fully open, spreader locked, all feet down; a tipped ladder permanently fails. No separate spec version is present.
comparison.reason: Although both involve bimanual stabilization and a lock, the ladder tests large-linkage deployment and stability, not precision tool use or iterative dynamic tuning.
